state.email: Hello, Quillon HR Cloud would like to offer our payroll and leave-tracking tool for your 900 staff. We will import employee records from your HR system. Documents uploaded. Net 30.

route.instructions: What kind of email is state.email? state.portal_documents lists what the sender uploaded to our supplier portal.

criteria.new_application: A company asks to become our supplier: it offers to supply us and applies, or says its documents are in the portal
criteria.existing_supplier_change: A supplier already on file asks to change its details, bank account or contacts
criteria.invoice_or_payment: An invoice, a payment reminder or a question about a payment
criteria.sales_pitch: Marketing that does not apply to become a supplier: a demo invitation, a discount, a newsletter
criteria.other: None of these, or it cannot be told from the email

category.instructions: What will the company in state.email supply?

criteria.goods: Physical products delivered to us: materials, parts, tools, packaging
criteria.services: Work done on our sites or for our staff: cleaning, catering, maintenance, consulting
criteria.software: Licenses, hosted tools or data services
criteria.logistics: Transport, storage or customs handling of goods
criteria.unclear: The email does not say what it will supply

handles_personal_data.instructions: Will the company in state.email handle personal data about our people (staff, customers)?

criteria.true: It will receive or store records about people: employee or customer records, payroll, HR data, contact lists
criteria.false: It works with goods, premises, company data or anonymous figures; serving or meeting our staff is not handling their data

nonstandard_terms.instructions: Do the payment terms in state.payment_terms differ from our standard terms (payment 30 days, 45 days after invoice)?

criteria.true: Shorter than 30 days, payment before delivery, a deposit or part paid in advance, or an early-payment discount
criteria.false: Payment 30 or 45 days after invoice, monthly or yearly invoicing included
